name: Ganti Password Web

endpoints.description: Mengubah password akun user yang sedang login setelah verifikasi password lama

error_codes.condition: field wajib kosong, atau new_password tidak memenuhi format min 6 karakter alfanumerik+simbol
old_password tidak cocok dengan password user saat ini

business_logic: 1. Validate request body (semua field wajib) → if invalid: return 422 VALIDATION_ERROR
2. Validate format new_password (min 6 karakter, alfanumerik+simbol) → if invalid: return 422 VALIDATION_ERROR
3. Validate new_password_confirmation cocok dengan new_password → if mismatch: return 422 PASSWORD_CONFIRMATION_MISMATCH
4. Verifikasi old_password terhadap hash password user saat ini → if salah: return 422 OLD_PASSWORD_INCORRECT
business_rules_applied: Password baru minimal 6 karakter, case-sensitive, alfanumerik+simbol

unit_test_cases.description: returns 422 VALIDATION_ERROR when a required field is missing
unit_test_cases.given: request body is missing one or more of old_password / new_password / new_password_confirmation
unit_test_cases.expect: throw ValidationException with code VALIDATION_ERROR, HTTP 422

unit_test_cases.description: returns 422 VALIDATION_ERROR when new_password does not meet format requirement
unit_test_cases.given: new_password does not satisfy min 6 characters, alphanumeric+symbol format
unit_test_cases.expect: throw ValidationException with code VALIDATION_ERROR, HTTP 422

unit_test_cases.description: returns 422 PASSWORD_CONFIRMATION_MISMATCH when new_password_confirmation does not match new_password
unit_test_cases.given: new_password_confirmation value differs from new_password value (both individually valid format)
unit_test_cases.expect: throw ValidationException with code PASSWORD_CONFIRMATION_MISMATCH, HTTP 422

unit_test_cases.description: returns 422 OLD_PASSWORD_INCORRECT when old_password does not match current user password hash
unit_test_cases.given: authService.verifyPassword(old_password, user.password_hash) returns false; all other fields valid
unit_test_cases.expect: throw UnprocessableEntityException with code OLD_PASSWORD_INCORRECT, HTTP 422

unit_test_cases.description: returns success result when all conditions pass
unit_test_cases.given: all fields present, new_password meets format, confirmation matches new_password, old_password matches current user.password_hash via authService.verifyPassword()
unit_test_cases.expect: userRepo.update() called with new hashed password_hash for the authenticated user; return 200 with success message

implementation_notes: Apakah sesi lama perlu di-invalidate/re-login setelah ganti password berhasil belum diputuskan (open question di business spec) — diasumsikan sesi tetap berlaku tanpa re-login paksa

component_test.action: fill old password field with the correct current password, fill new password and confirmation fields with a matching valid new password, click tombol Simpan
component_test.assert: success confirmation message displayed, form fields reset, no validation/error state shown

browser_test.action: navigate to Ganti Password page via menu Pengaturan Akun, fill old password, new password, and confirmation with valid matching values, click Simpan
browser_test.assert: success confirmation message/banner is shown on the page after submission

test_scenarios.scenario_ref: Ganti Password Web — Password Lama Salah

component_test.action: fill old password field with an incorrect password, fill valid new password and matching confirmation, click Simpan
component_test.assert: error message displayed stating old password is incorrect; password remains unchanged

browser_test.action: on Ganti Password page, enter an incorrect old password with a valid new password and confirmation, click Simpan
browser_test.assert: error message shown that old password is wrong; no success confirmation appears; account password unchanged

test_scenarios.scenario_ref: Ganti Password Web — Password Baru Tidak Memenuhi Format

component_test.action: fill valid old password, fill new password that does not meet format requirement (e.g. too short / missing symbol), fill matching confirmation, click Simpan
component_test.assert: validation error message displayed for password format; password remains unchanged

browser_test.action: on Ganti Password page, enter valid old password and a new password not meeting the min 6 char alphanumeric+symbol format, with matching confirmation, click Simpan
browser_test.assert: validation error message about password format shown; account password unchanged

test_scenarios.scenario_ref: Ganti Password Web — Konfirmasi Tidak Cocok

component_test.action: fill valid old password, fill new password and a different confirmation value, click Simpan
component_test.assert: error message displayed stating confirmation does not match new password; password remains unchanged

browser_test.action: on Ganti Password page, enter valid old password and new password, but a non-matching confirmation value, click Simpan
browser_test.assert: error message shown that confirmation does not match new password; account password unchanged
